verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an API platform like Morph, but the pack documents no batch endpoint or multi-item operation. The closest item is the `service_tier: "standby"` discount, described as "built for batch and background workloads". It is a per-request priority and pricing tier, not a way to submit or act on many items at once, so it is an adjacent feature that earns no credit. Fast Apply, Compact, Reflexes and the MCP tools are likewise documented only as single-request operations.
